title: Token bucket rate limiter
description: Implement class TokenBucket(capacity, refill_per_sec) with method allow(now, cost=1) -> bool. The bucket starts full. On each call, first add (now - last_seen_time) * refill_per_sec tokens, capped at capacity, then consume cost tokens and return True if enough are available, else return False and consume nothing. The first call sets last_seen_time to its now value with no refill.
invariants: Constructor raises ValueError if capacity <= 0 or refill_per_sec < 0.
A cost larger than capacity always returns False and consumes nothing.
If now is earlier than the last seen time, add no tokens and do not move last_seen_time backwards.
A refused request must not consume tokens.
